7z4c: The Master's in Criminal Justice is designed for individuals committed to making a difference in law enforcement, corrections and the justice system. With a focus on critical thinking, research and hands-on experience, students will gain the advanced skills and knowledge needed to lead in today's complex criminal justice landscape. Students learn from faculty who are leading experts in their fields.

The UMass Lowell master's program combines educational theory and practice with authentic well supported field-based experiences. This prepares teacher candidates to enter the teaching profession with the content, confidence and skills necessary to be successful. Well-supported field-based experiences embedded throughout their preparation programs.

The department's virtual simulations and partnerships with local school districts, including Lawrence, Lowell, Billerica, Chelmsford, Dracut, Haverhill, Methuen, Westford and local technical schools give students real-world opportunities to hone their teaching skills before they begin their student teaching semester. Coursework and field experiences address the contemporary demands of teaching students in a diverse world of changing demographics - ensuring that students are truly “classroom-ready” when they graduate.
7z4y: Community Music Option is for students seeking music education beyond traditional school settings, such as community outreach programs, arts organizations and educational media.
7z4z: Teaching Certification Option: For students aiming to become licensed music educators in public schools, this pathway combines comprehensive coursework in music and general education with hands-on teaching practicums. Upon completion, students will be eligible to apply for Initial Licensure through the Massachusetts Department of Education, positioning them as fully certified music teachers in the state. (Note that the Commonwealth has teacher licensure reciprocity with most states.)
7z5s: The University's highly acclaimed Master of Business Administration Degree will prepare students to lead organizations in today's rapidly changing business environment. Students can tailor their MBA to their career goals and interests by selecting from options in accounting, business analytics, entrepreneurship, finance, healthcare, information technology, international business, managerial leadership or marketing.
